notes: «قالوا حدثنا سفيان» is said by the two co-transmitters of the second branch; the tail (سفيان onward) belongs to both branches, as «قالا حدثنا وكيع» links the first.
RWY reads the two branches as separate routes; the text's «قالا/قالوا» makes them meet at سفيان.
«أتانا النبي ... فساومنا سراويل» is Suwayd's narration: Suwayd is the last link.
